tuning.changesApplied: none — default BM25 column weights (path=8.0, title=6.0, heading=5.0, body=1.0, identifier_aliases=4.0) already in ledger::index::recall_fts were evaluated as-is on dev and were decisively ahead of legacy_scan; no weight/normalization changes were made or needed before freezing the candidate for held-out.

evaluation.decisionRule: ledger_fts activates iff heldout.ledger_fts.mrr >= heldout.legacy_scan.mrr AND heldout.ledger_fts.recallAt5 >= heldout.legacy_scan.recallAt5 - 0.02
evaluation.notes: Both arms measured via ledger::doc_spine::recall_shadow (production sync + both live recall lanes computed simultaneously; no separate/synthetic code path per arm). legacy_scan (whole-document lexical scan + best-section reselection) underperforms materially on both splits; ledger_fts (BM25 over ledger_node_fts) wins decisively on every headline metric on both dev and heldout, with the largest gap on identifier/exact-section/table/fenced-code categories and expected weakness on negative_no_answer (0.0 recall on both arms/splits, consistent with abstention not being implemented as a scored behavior in either lane) and short_query. MEMBRANE_DOC_PROVIDER_ENABLED (planner federation of the doc candidate provider) is a separate promotion and is left untouched by this qualification.
